description: Ownership records (one row per owner per parcel) for an owner, owner_key, mailing address or pin, or every transfer recorded in one county over up to 3 calendar months. Filter by price, current vs former, and address; sort by date or price. Use it for questions like 'who bought in Davidson in March 2024 over $1M'.

address.description: Property address words (filters the other results).

current.description: true = current owners only, false = former owners only.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Results per page, 1–200 (default varies by tool).

name: search_ownership_records
title: Search ownership records / transfers
